mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS user_id, last_login_ip AS last_login_ip FROM tb_user WHERE del_flag = 0 AND last_login_ip IS NOT NULL AND last_login_ip != ''

SELECT CASE WHEN total_amount < 100 THEN '低消费' WHEN total_amount < 500 THEN '中消费' ELSE '高消费' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM tb_order WHERE order_status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) t GROUP BY level ORDER BY FIELD(level, '低消费', '中消费', '高消费')

SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS buy_count FROM tb_order_item oi JOIN tb_product p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN tb_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN tb_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0 AND oi.del_flag = 0 AND p.del_flag = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY buy_count DESC
